resources.string: Locks the screen when you double-tap empty space on the home screen.

MS Launcher uses this service only to lock the screen when you double-tap an empty part of the home screen, and to open the notification panel when you swipe down. It cannot read your screen, the text you type, or other apps\' windows, and it does not collect, store or send any data. You can turn it off any time in Launcher settings.
